notes: litert-community/gpt-oss-120b: gpt_oss_120b_mixed_int4_ekv4096.litertlm, a LiteRT-LM conversion of openai/gpt-oss-120b at revision b5c939de (Apache-2.0), a 36-layer mixture-of-experts decoder (128 experts per layer, 4 used for each token) with attention sinks, alternating 128-token sliding-window and full attention and YaRN positions, which reasons in an analysis channel before its final answer; written with the LiteRT Tensor API one tensor at a time: each layer's experts in one `moe` custom op with int4 blockwise-32 weights (fp32 scales) and GELU (tanh form) without the source's clamps, because LiteRT-LM 0.19.1's moe op has no clamped SwiGLU (the card and the README say how far that moves the outputs); attention and lm_head int8 per channel, fp32 activations declared, a 4,096-token cache; the checkpoint's tokenizer.json byte for byte. Runs on the CPU (XNNPACK) only: the file is 77.3 GB and is mapped, so it needs a 128 GB Mac; no GPU or phone row. Line 4 (the benchmark protocol registered before any run, on a LiteRT-LM built from source with two open LiteRT pull requests) is in the record, not here (not a release). Landed 2026-11-10: litert-community/gpt-oss-120b is public and ungated (license apache-2.0, base_model openai/gpt-oss-120b quantized, library_name litert-lm), upload commit c903efbfef (2026-11-09T22:55:13.000Z), main 60de77f09b at the read; the tree's LFS oid and size of gpt_oss_120b_mixed_int4_ekv4096.litertlm = artifact_sha256 and 77259120896 B (anonymous, read 2026-11-10 12:30:04 JST); the Hub's bytes at the upload commit streamed and hashed again = artifact_sha256 (stream_sha_gpt_oss_120b_mixed_int4_ekv4096.litertlm.json).
quantization: experts int4 blockwise (block 32, an fp32 scale per block chosen by least squared error, re-quantized from the source's MXFP4 values, scales floored at 2^-14); attention q / k / v / o and lm_head int8 per channel; router, biases, sinks, norms and the token table fp32; fp32 activations declared (prefer_activation_type fp32); KV cache 4,096 tokens
